forms.module.name: Forms
forms.module.description: The form builder: a theatre's own forms, with logic, versions and, where a form wants one, review and a decision.
forms.settings.limits.questions-per-form: A form with more questions than this cannot be saved.
forms.settings.limits.pages-per-form.hel: A form with more pages than this cannot be saved.
forms.settings.limits.definition-size.he: The size of a form's questions and logic together, not of its answers.
forms.settings.limits.repeat-entries.lab: Most entries in a repeating group
forms.settings.limits.repeat-entries.hel: The most times a person may repeat one group of questions.
forms.settings.limits.condition-depth.he: How many levels of "all of" and "any of" a condition may have.
forms.settings.builder.free-patterns.lab: Let authors write their own patterns
forms.settings.builder.free-patterns.hel: Allows a regular expression as a question's validation. The ready-made patterns are always offered.
Ask how long answers are kept before publishing
A form that asks for personal answers cannot be published until it says how long they are kept.
forms.abilities.form.create.label: Start a new form
forms.abilities.form.edit.label: Build and edit a form
forms.abilities.form.publish.label: Publish a form
forms.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change the forms settings
forms.settings.limits.response-size.help: The most one person's answers may come to, whether sent or kept as a working copy.
forms.settings.limits.export-rows.label: Responses in one export
forms.settings.limits.export-rows.help: The most responses one CSV export holds. A larger set is exported in parts, by date.
forms.abilities.response.read.label: Read a form's responses, except restricted answers
forms.abilities.response.export.label: Export a form's responses
